fonts.display: 'ABCfavorit Book', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'ABCfavorit Book', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Parchment
palette.role: Primary page canvas — the warm off-white that gives the entire system its editorial, non-digital feel

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Card surfaces, badge fills, and inset panels — sits one step above the parchment canvas to create gentle elevation without shadows

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, default borders, nav strokes, and structural outlines — the dominant typographic and border color across all contexts

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Secondary headings and heavier-weight text where slightly softer than Ink Black is desired

palette.name: Aubergine Black
palette.role: Dramatic dark-section backgrounds (Problem, full-bleed inverse bands) — the only near-saturated tone, used to invert the page temperature

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted text, inactive states, and lighter border treatments where Ink Black would be too heavy

palette.name: Dim
palette.role: Captions, timestamps, and tertiary metadata where hierarchy needs to recede

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Hairline borders, illustration fills, and low-emphasis dividers — the lightest structural line color
